name: PEE-thread Crofton salvage of refuted HYP-014
claim: HYP-2026-014 was REFUTED because it used a naive uniform-chord Crofton measure, predicting a sinusoidal profile sigma ~ sin(pi*dr/N) that gave a 5863% residual against the SIM-2026-016 sigma theta-data. The correct integral-geometry object is NOT the uniform chord-length measure but the Kirillov-Kostant symplectic form on a coadjoint orbit, realized as the PEE-thread (partial-entanglement-entropy thread) tessellation of kinematic space (Wen-Xu-Zhong arXiv:2512.19452; Penna-Zukowski arXiv:1812.02176). This hypothesis claims that re-deriving the holographic force/sigma profile as a Crofton integral against the PEE-thread measure d-mu_PEE(theta) = (Kirillov-Kostant density) rather than the uniform measure d-theta yields a power-law tail F(dr) ~ dr^{-alpha} with alpha consistent with the established alpha approximately 4.0 (24q exact 3.92, 16q exact 3.97, 16q chi=3 MERA 4.07), in the same dr range where the uniform-chord measure produced the refuted sinusoid. Concretely: the PEE-thread density on the boundary circle is rho_PEE(theta) proportional to 1/sin^2(theta/2) (the kinematic-space metric weight, equivalently the Crofton kernel of the hyperbolic plane), not the constant density implicit in HYP-014. Re-weighting the existing sigma theta-files by this kernel and refitting should convert the refuted sin(pi*dr/N) shape into a dr^{-4} power law.
confidence_rationale: Medium, not high, for three reasons. (1) The mathematical chain is strong and converging: two independent recent sources (Wen-Xu-Zhong 2512.19452, Penna-Zukowski 1812.02176) identify the Kirillov-Kostant / PEE-thread measure as the correct Crofton object for tensor-network kinematic space, and the hyperbolic Crofton kernel 1/sin^2(theta/2) is a standard, parameter-free result of integral geometry on H^2 -- this is not a fitted form. (2) The target alpha approximately 4 is independently established by three measurements that STAND (paper v4), so this is a zero-free-parameter consistency test, not a fishing expedition. (3) Confidence is held below high because HYP-014's prior failure shows the discretization of the continuum Crofton kernel onto an N-site MERA is exactly where the physics was lost before -- the finite-N regularization of 1/sin^2(theta/2) (which diverges at theta -> 0) requires a principal-value or thread-cutoff prescription whose specific choice could still spoil the power law. The reanalysis is cheap enough that this risk is acceptable.
test_design: Zero-cost re-analysis of existing data; NO new simulation or quantum circuit. Steps: (1) Load the existing sigma theta-files used in SIM-2026-016 (sigma_by_dr for dr=1..12 at N=24, and the underlying angular CMI/PEE distribution if stored; otherwise reconstruct theta-binned sigma from the SIM-2026-016 CMI tensor). (2) From PAPER-2026-044 (Wen-Xu-Zhong) and Penna-Zukowski 1812.02176, write the PEE-thread / Kirillov-Kostant Crofton density for the kinematic space of an N=24 boundary circle: rho_PEE(theta) = (c/12) * 1/sin^2(theta/2) (the standard hyperbolic Crofton kernel; the central-charge prefactor cancels under normalization). (3) Compute the predicted force/sigma profile F_PEE(dr) = integral over geodesics of chord = dr of rho_PEE(theta) with the finite-N thread cutoff theta_min = pi/N (principal-value regularization at the coincident-point divergence). (4) Fit F_PEE(dr) over dr=1..12 to a power law dr^{-alpha} and to the refuted sinusoid sin(pi*dr/N); compare reduced chi^2 and extracted alpha. (5) Cross-check against SIM-2026-015d chi=3 sigma data if available. Implementation: ~30-60 lines Python/NumPy/SciPy against research/data/simulations/SIM-2026-016.json. Single-parameter normalization at dr=1 only; alpha is a derived output, not a fit input.
refutation_criteria: This hypothesis is REFUTED if any of the following hold: (a) the PEE-thread-weighted profile F_PEE(dr) fit to dr^{-alpha} over dr=1..12 yields alpha outside [3.2, 4.8] (the established acceptance window from SIM-2026-023), i.e. the correct Crofton measure does NOT recover the known alpha approximately 4; (b) a sinusoidal fit sin(pi*dr/N) still beats the power-law fit on reduced chi^2 (meaning the measure choice did not change the functional form and HYP-014's refutation stands for the right reason); (c) the result is unstable under the finite-N thread-cutoff prescription -- i.e. alpha varies by more than +/-0.5 as theta_min is swept over [pi/(2N), 2pi/N], indicating the power law is an artifact of the regularization rather than the kernel. Any of (a), (b), or (c) refutes the salvage and confirms HYP-014 stays refuted.
hardware_required: Local CPU only. Python/NumPy/SciPy re-analysis of research/data/simulations/SIM-2026-016.json (and optionally SIM-2026-015d.json). No quantum hardware, no new simulation.
feasibility_notes: FEASIBILITY-CHECKER VERDICT (2026-05-15): TESTABLE_NOW, CONFIRMED with mandatory regulator guard. (1) DATA AVAILABILITY VERIFIED: the conjecture-generator's claim of 're-weighting existing sigma theta-files' is IMPRECISE but the test is still zero-cost. SIM-2026-016.json stores only sigma_by_dr (already collapsed over angle) and F_measured -- it does NOT persist a theta-resolved angular distribution or the K[u,v] kinematic-space matrix. HOWEVER gs_24q_exact.npy (134 MB, 2^24 amplitudes, norm=1.0) IS on disk and loadable, and sim2026016_kinematic_space.py reconstructs the full K[u,v]=d^2S/dudv matrix from it in ~79 s. The PEE-thread re-weight therefore reweights |K[u,v]| by 1/sin^2(theta(u,v)/2), where theta maps interval endpoints (u,v) to the boundary circle. Net cost: one ~80 s local CPU recompute of S(u,v) over the 24q GS plus the ~30-60 line re-weight/fit. No quantum hardware, no cloud. HARDWARE/CIRCUIT/RESOURCE: trivially within budget (local CPU, ~80 s, ~1.5 GB RAM for 2^24 vector -- under the 16 GB local ceiling; no eigsh, so the local-memory-pressure note does not bite). MATHEMATICAL: the 1/sin^2(theta/2) hyperbolic Crofton kernel is a standard parameter-free result; the target alpha~4 is independently established (SIM-2026-015d: 16q exact 3.975, chi=3 4.071; SIM-2026-023 bootstrap 4.077+/-0.286). This is a genuine zero-free-parameter consistency test, NOT curve-fitting. (2) REGULATOR GUARD (this is salvage of a REFUTED result -- bar is high): the 1/sin^2(theta/2) divergence at theta->0 is exactly the discretization step where HYP-014 lost the physics. The hypothesis's refutation criterion (c) (alpha must not vary by >+/-0.5 as theta_min sweeps [pi/(2N), 2pi/N]) is necessary but UNDERSPECIFIED -- a sweep over a single decade of theta_min can still hide a power-law that is manufactured by ANY hard cutoff. MANDATORY ADDITIONAL CHECK before any 'salvaged' verdict: (i) report alpha(theta_min) as a continuous curve over at least [pi/(4N), 4pi/N] (two decades), not just the endpoints; (ii) run the IDENTICAL re-weight+regulator pipeline on a NULL control -- a non-CFT/non-critical reference K-matrix (e.g. a product-state or gapped-chain S(u,v)) -- and confirm it does NOT also produce alpha in [3.2,4.8]; if the regulator alone manufactures alpha~4 on the null control, criterion (c) has failed and HYP-014 stays refuted; (iii) report the principal-value vs hard-cutoff prescriptions side by side -- agreement within +/-0.3 in alpha is required. (3) Caveat carried from HYP-014: SIM-2026-016 used the 24q EXACT GS (chi-exact, not chi=2 -- the hypothesis text's chi=2 caveat is inaccurate; the relevant cross-check is SIM-2026-015d chi=3, which is cheaper and available). VERDICT: TESTABLE_NOW, no blocking issues, but the salvage is only credited if the null-control check (2-ii) passes.
philosophical_implications: HYP-014's refutation was widely read as evidence that the holographic force is NOT an integral-geometry (Crofton) quantity. If this salvage succeeds, the correct reading is the opposite: the force IS a Crofton integral, but over the Kirillov-Kostant symplectic measure of kinematic space, not over naive chord length. This would mean the refutation of HYP-014 was a refutation of the WRONG measure, not of the integral-geometry program -- a clean Popperian distinction. Conceptually, it would establish that the emergent bulk force is the pushforward of a coadjoint-orbit symplectic form onto the boundary, tying the holographic force directly to the representation theory of the conformal group rather than to metric geodesic counting. It also sharpens an epistemic lesson for this research line: a refuted hypothesis can be a refuted parameterization of a true structure, and zero-cost re-analysis with the corrected mathematical object is the disciplined way to tell the two apart before discarding the structure.

status_writeback_2026_08_17.which_branch_fired: Branch (a) of this record's own refutation_criteria: the PEE-thread-weighted profile fit gives alpha = 0.883, outside the registered acceptance window. The Kirillov-Kostant measure did not convert the refuted sinusoid into a power law at the target exponent.
status_writeback_2026_08_17.robustness_to_the_alpha_withdrawal: The [3.2, 4.8] acceptance window was anchored on the alpha ~= 4 that SIM-2026-072 has now WITHDRAWN (corrected value alpha = 2.6 +/- 0.2). The refutation survives the re-anchoring: 0.883 is outside [2.4, 2.8] as decisively as it was outside [3.2, 4.8], and it remains a factor of ~3 below the corrected exponent. REFUTED stands on either anchor. This is stated explicitly because a salvage of a refuted result deserves the check rather than the assumption.
status_writeback_2026_08_17.vacuous_guard_disclosure: The audit (section 6.3) finds that two of the three 'mandatory guards' written into this record's feasibility_notes -- the regulator-stability sweep in particular -- are structurally incapable of failing, because the regulator never binds over the fit window. Nothing was mis-credited, since the verdict was REFUTED regardless; but a SUPPORTED verdict here would have rested on guards that could not have caught anything. Recorded so the guard design is not reused as-is.
